annotation.justification: The clause provides a clear directive for when an origin server should send a Vary header field. It specifies the conditions under which the Vary header should be used (when representation selection varies based on request aspects other than method and target URI) and exceptions (when variance cannot be crossed or when configured to prevent cache transparency). The language is prescriptive and does not allow for multiple materially different interpretations that would affect implementation behavior.
